result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may assign without consent to an Affiliate or transaction successor; Licensor assignments require reasonably withheld consent and are prohibited to Licensee competitors; and Licensee changes of control create no Licensor termination right. However, it goes beyond the playbook by adding reorganization/equity-sale language, a new post-closing notice obligation, and express suspension and re-pricing prohibitions. Drafting should also conform the void-assignment sentence to the carve-outs (e.g., assignments “in violation of this Section” are void) and fix the run-on phrase “this Section Subject to.”
